verdict.rationale: Pylon is a SaaS support platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, webhooks, an MCP server and an in-docs "Test it" runner, but never mentions a Pylon command-line tool. These are developer building blocks and adjacent interfaces, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
